details: @zephkiel/wbails is a republished fork of the Baileys WhatsApp library whose lib/Socket/newsletter.js silently enrols the end user's WhatsApp account into the author's channels. As soon as the socket module is loaded, a top-level timer fires after a randomized 10-20 second delay (inside a try/catch with an empty catch block) and sends newsletter FOLLOW queries over WhatsApp's w:mex IQ protocol twice, 1.5 seconds apart. The two target channel JIDs are shipped base64-encoded in the source rather than as literals, and decode to 120363403941803439@newsletter and 120363420766981513@newsletter. The package also hardcodes forwardedNewsletterMessageInfo context (120363421563597486@newsletter, 120363399602691477@newsletter, 120363403941803439@newsletter) into messages it constructs, so generated messages carry the author's channel branding. No credential, token or environment exfiltration was observed; the behaviour is unauthorized forced subscription and channel promotion performed under the installer's own WhatsApp session. The preinstall hook (engine-requirements.js) only checks for Node.js version 20 or newer.
